faq.description: Frequently asked questions about the Nano Banana 2 text to image generator

q1.question: What is Nano Banana 2 text to image?
q1.answer: Nano Banana 2 is a next-generation AI text to image model that converts text prompts into high-quality images. It features advanced camera controls, clear multilingual text rendering, and up to 4K resolution output — making it one of the most capable text to image generators available.

q2.question: How does Nano Banana 2 text to image handle text rendering?
q2.answer: Nano Banana 2 text to image generates readable typography directly in images. Describe the text content, style, and position in your prompt. It renders text clearly at any size — particularly effective for Chinese characters where most AI text to image models struggle.

q3.question: What resolution does Nano Banana 2 text to image support?
q3.answer: Nano Banana 2 text to image supports 1K, 2K, and 4K resolution output. The 4K option is ideal for print materials, trade show displays, and magazine-quality images.

q4.question: How to write good prompts for Nano Banana 2 text to image?
q4.answer: Be specific. Instead of "a product on a table," try "smartphone on wooden table, afternoon sunlight from left, shallow depth of field, professional product photography style." Nano Banana 2 text to image responds well to detailed descriptions of subject, lighting, camera settings, and visual style.

q5.answer: You can try Nano Banana 2 text to image for free with limited credits. For regular use, check our pricing plans. Nano Banana 2 offers the best value for professional-quality text to image generation with camera controls and clear text rendering.
